title: THE FEED ZONE IS A QUARTER WIDE
why: Seen in the picture of the busy raid frame: the feed zone reserved 30 percent of the screen width while its lines are under two thirds of that, so the controls list beside it was squeezed to a tiny size. The zone is now a quarter of the width and each line is a little tighter, so the ten lines are about 280 pixels tall at 1080p and the controls list keeps a readable size.
now: The feed zone is now a quarter of the screen wide, so the controls list beside it stays readable.

edits.anchor: var rs=Math.max(1,hudRes()), fp=msgPx(hudFS(TYPE.label)), rh=Math.round(fp*1.5), gap=Math.max(2,Math.round(LH(2)*rs)), B=HUDBOX.body, h=FEED.show*rh+(FEED.show-1)*gap, bot;
